source.title: Hardware Hacking for the absolute beginner - Jilles Groenendijk
source.description: In this Hardware Hacking Workshop for the absolute beginner, Jilles will tell you about the challenges of hardware security and teach you how to identify the different components of a device. The different ways you can attack hardware and he will even show you protocols at '0' and '1' level. All in his humorous style and no-nonsense attitude. According to Jilles, € 20 will get you very far and most participants will run to the thrift store to get their hands dirty! At the end of the lecture is a small CTF where you can experience what you have just learned. Buyers guide to get started in hardware hacking : https://github.com/yadox666/The-Hackers-Hardware-Toolkit

editorial.why_selected: A hackerspace workshop on hardware hacking for absolute beginners: how to open a device, find its debug ports, and learn what's inside.
learning_outcomes: The basic tools and safety steps for opening electronics
How to find and identify debug interfaces like UART
editorial.try_next: Open an old router or gadget you no longer need and photograph its board; label the chips you can identify.
editorial.context_note: Long (about two hours); a recorded workshop at TkkrLab.
